description:
Wrapper-level differential test for pkix_chain::verify_smime_signer and verify_smime_recipient against 'openssl verify -purpose smimesign/smimeencrypt -verify_email X'.

Source corpus: pkix-chain/tests/fixtures/ mailbox-*.der (authored under PKIX-fmtv.23). The signer wrapper uses smimesign purpose; the recipient wrapper uses smimeencrypt purpose (despite the name, this is the recipient/encryption-target purpose in OpenSSL's vocabulary).

Acceptance:
- pkix-difftest/tests/verify_wrapper_openssl_smime.rs covers both wrappers.
- baseline-verify-openssl.md gets a S/MIME section.

Blocks on PKIX-fmtv.18.1.
title: OpenSSL diff: verify_smime_signer/recipient vs -purpose smimesign/smimeencrypt -verify_email
